take_to_heart:
• Trust in God's promises even when circumstances seem uncertain.
• Walk in daily obedience to Scripture in your personal conduct.
• Seek Christ daily through prayer and active fellowship.
todays_prayer: Lord God, thank You for Your living Word in Zephaniah 1-3. Open our eyes to see Your truth today, grant us wisdom to apply it, and fill our hearts with love for Your Son, Jesus Christ. Amen.
verse_to_remember: Your word is a lamp to my feet and a light to my path.
